Description: A gatekeeper run is judged against its SKILL contract: run the privacy guard and hash a manifest over the artifacts, post the versioned approval receipt, spell out the owner's two moves, leave the ticket in Review, and never settle the decision itself.

Criteria.Name: Dispatch behaved as declared
Criteria.Statement: The run did not behave the way the fixture declares, so nothing downstream of it can be trusted.

Criteria.Name: Posted the versioned approval receipt
Criteria.Statement: SKILL.md requires the receipt as the first line of every successful gate comment; without it a label alone is never proof that the current bytes were reviewed.

Criteria.Name: Guarded and hashed the artifacts
Criteria.Statement: The gate was reported without running the privacy guard or building the manifest it hashes.

Criteria.Name: Stated both owner moves and left the ticket in Review
Values: move the ticket back to Todo
Criteria.Statement: A gated ticket waits in Review for a human, and nothing dispatches from Review — the comment must name both moves literally or the thread dies there.

Criteria.Name: Did not settle the decision itself
Criteria.Statement: Approval is a label plus an owner decision, never one the gatekeeper issues on the owner's behalf.

Criteria.Name: Did not waive the gate
Criteria.Statement: The gate was waived rather than held.
